chunks: And Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdullah عليه السلام:
Regarding a man who marries a woman while she has a husband, he said:
If his case is not brought to the Imam, then he must give five sa's of flour in charity. This is after he separates from her.

key_terms.الْإِمَامِ: the Imam, the authoritative religious leader and judge
key_terms.خَمْسَةِ أَصْوَاعٍ: five sa's, a specific measured quantity
key_terms.دَقِيقًا: flour given as the charitable payment
key_terms.زَوْجٌ: a husband already bound to the woman
key_terms.يَتَصَدَّقَ: to give in charity as an expiatory payment

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man marries a woman who is already married?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a man who marries a woman who already has a husband. If the matter is not formally raised before the Imam, he must separate from her and give five sa's of flour as charity.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.4638 - Abu Basir narrated from Abu Abdullah (as) regarding a man who marries a woman while she has a husband.
Imam (as) said: "If the matter is not brought to the attention of the Imam, he must give five sa' (measures) of flour in charity. This is after he separates from her."
